silhouette.reason: Reads as a big cat / tiger from the side and 3/4: level back, low head, deep chest, digitigrade legs, J-hanging tail with a black tip (silhouette IoU LOD2 0.93-0.95). Against the Schönbrunn side photos the trunk is a little long and tubular, the neck long, the hind thigh shallow, and the ears read small and slightly 'mouse-cup' from the front; the winter ruff barely changes the outline.
fixes: shorten the trunk masses ~5% and deepen the chest at the brisket so the waist tuck reads
grow the cheek ruff lobes outward/down (ruff.ts) so the front silhouette widens below the ears like an Amur in winter
raise and enlarge the hamstring/quadriceps masses so the haunch reads as a powerful thigh in side view

proportions.reason: Sourced numbers hold in code: head+body 1.957 m (1.95), tail 0.987 m (0.99), withers 1.013 m (0.8-1.1), mass 237 kg (Mazák 180-306), limb allometry 264 kg. By eye beside the photos the head is still slightly small and low, the muzzle a touch long and the forearms a little thin for an Amur male.
fixes: shorten the muzzle 1 cm and widen the whisker pads (face.ts)

a fur material strip that does not darken the vertex colour (the library `fur` strip's brown albedo mutes orange, so plain was used)
per-vertex stripe colour on a finer head/body cell at LOD0 or a stripe texture lane
